Counting Caterpillar Worksheet for Age 4

Age 4 YearsClass 24 · MathsType Printable PDFPlays with the Maths Room

Count every circle of the caterpillar, trace the number you find, and count rows of apples along the way.

On the sheet: Count the caterpillar’s circles, trace the number, and count each apple row.

THE ACTUAL WORKSHEET

Exactly what you’ll print.

This is the real sheet — the same file the buttons above hand you. Title, instructions, the activity itself, and a grown-up answer line where it helps.

The PDF is a real printable file (A4, prints fine on US Letter). The print button prints only the worksheet — never the website around it. No sign-up, nothing stored.

ABOUT THIS WORKSHEET

What your child practices.

The caterpillar is made of ten numbered circle segments — counting them one by one, with a finger on each circle, is classic one-to-one counting practice. Tracing the numeral 10 afterwards connects “how many” with “what it looks like written down”.

  • Counting objects one by one to 10
  • Touch-counting without skipping
  • Tracing and writing the number 10
  • Counting small groups of apples
HOW TO USE IT

Three easy steps.

  1. Count out loud together

    Touch each thing as you count it — finger on apple, circle on caterpillar. Touching keeps the count honest.

  2. Write big

    The answer boxes are big on purpose. Big wobbly numerals are exactly what they should be at four.

  3. Check by counting again

    Counting a second time (and getting the same number!) is the skill. Celebrate the recount, not just the answer.

TEACHING TIPS

Little things that help.

Use real things first

Count spoons, steps and apples in the kitchen before the pencil comes out. Numbers live in the world first.

Mistakes are data

If the count comes out different each time, slow down and count as a team. That is the whole lesson.

Keep sessions tiny

One sheet, maybe two rows of it, is plenty for a four-year-old’s counting stamina.

Answer guide

The caterpillar has 10 circles. The apple rows have 3, 5 and 2.
